_original_lore: Zealots are a type of Enderman found exclusively
in the Dragon's Nest. Zealots are not hostile towards
players, unless provoked, like normal Enderman.
name: 末地战士 (怪物)

source: Zealots are a type of Enderman found exclusively
in the Dragon's Nest. Zealots are not hostile towards
players, unless provoked, like normal Enderman.
loreParagraphs.translation: 末地战士是一种仅出没于龙巢的末影人.除非被激怒,末地战士不会像普通末影人那样主动攻击玩家.
